topic: CoffeeMan's anonymous-cart free-delivery observation applied at its observed scope
method: The live-parsed CoffeeMan listings were quoted through the production quote engine at each cart size observed in the anonymous checkout on 2026-10-12; no order, login, account, street address or bot-challenge bypass was involved in that research.
